title: A remembrancer proposals file
description: Dispositions for `remembrancer apply`, applied in one locked step or refused whole. `mode` says who wrote it and so which actions it may take: manual (an agent or a person) and insight (a strong model's run) take every action; gather (a cheap model's run) only classifies (retag, link, flag, cluster), and its archive becomes `suggest: archive`; only manual and insight runs may condense.

packet.description: the hash of the curation packet the file answers, if any

by.description: who made it: claude, a script, a model's name
